description: In-memory scoring cache with TTL. ScoringCache class: get(server_id)->dict|None, set(server_id,data,ttl_seconds=3600), invalidate(server_id), clear_expired(). Uses dict with {data,expires_at} per server_id. Thread-safe with threading.Lock. clear_expired() called on every get to avoid unbounded growth. Global instance: _cache=ScoringCache(). Reduces repeated ws_query calls when signal_analyser processes same server multiple times per cycle. No daemon.
